propertyFacts.label: Limits of the thiourea library
propertyFacts.value: N,N′-disubstituted and most trisubstituted thioureas were too reactive for tunable size control at useful growth temperatures; most tetrasubstituted thioureas were sluggish where cadmium carboxylate was stable.
propertyFacts.scope: Source-wide comparison; no precise threshold, reaction time or individual failure batch is supplied.

propertyFacts.label: Source electronic and steric reactivity trend
propertyFacts.value: Electron-donating thiocarbonate substituents accelerate conversion; ortho substitution inhibits it. The 2,6-xylyl 1j precursor is much slower than p-tolyl 1c. Less-reactive precursors generally yield larger CdS nanocrystals, with partial yields also influencing size.
propertyFacts.scope: Source class-level comparison under standardized reaction conditions; not a hold duration assigned to every individual CdS recipe.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
